units.text: Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice .

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.
All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.
The opportunity

TechnologyAdvice is looking for a Client Success Operations Coordinator to help keep client campaigns running smoothly. You’ll work behind the scenes with our Client Success and internal operations teams to set up programs, track deliverables, prepare reports, and catch issues before they affect delivery.

This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys detailed work, keeps multiple projects organized, and follows through when something needs to be fixed. You’ll help the team deliver on client commitments through accurate execution and clear internal communication.
Employment Level: Entry Level
Employment Type: Full-time
Location: Philippines
Working Hours: 9PM to 6AM PHT (Apr - Oct) or 10PM to 7AM PHT (Nov - Mar)
What you'll do
Set up and maintain client programs in Salesforce, making sure campaign details, requirements, and timelines are accurate.
Monitor active programs, track deliverables, and flag pacing, quality, or execution issues to the right team members.
Troubleshoot campaign setup and delivery issues, working with internal teams to resolve them.
Prepare regular campaign reports and check data for accuracy before sharing it with the Client Success team.
Coordinate internal handoffs and follow up on open items so work stays on track.
Review leads and campaign elements against program requirements and flag anything that needs correction.
Keep campaign records and process documentation organized and up to date.
Identify recurring issues and suggest practical ways to improve team workflows.
Who you are
Agile professional who excels in a fast-paced environment and thrives on continuously pivoting strategies to drive business needs forward.
Highly organized and comfortable managing several programs and deadlines at once.
Detail-oriented, especially when working with campaign requirements, data, and reports.
A clear communicator who can give useful updates, ask questions, and follow up with internal teams.
Proficient in Google Sheets or Excel, with the ability to manage data, build reports, and check for accuracy.
Familiar with Salesforce or a similar CRM, or able to learn new systems quickly.
Proactive about spotting issues, finding answers, and escalating problems when needed.
Interested in learning how B2B demand generation campaigns work.
Must have a working laptop/pc and, internet, and a backup connection.

*The duties and responsibilities listed above describe the post as it is in general terms and are not definitive. The job holder is expected to accept any reasonable alterations that may from time to time be necessary. **
What we offer you
Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy 14 days of annual paid time off, plus all regular Philippine government-declared holidays to unwind and recharge. Plus 5 additional days after 1 year.
Comprehensive Coverage: Full enrollment in Philippine statutory benefits: SSS, PhilHealth, and HDMF.
Healthcare : Corporate HMO Plan for all full-time PH employees upon completion of two months of tenure.
De Minimis Allowance: Enjoy a monthly rice subsidy, following government guidelines.
Wellness Perks: Access the Headspace app to support your well-being.
Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.
Work authorization

Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Philippines at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the Philippines throughout their employment with our company.
Salary Range

We seek to hire top-tier individuals and intend for our compensation to be at a rate that allows us to recruit and retain individuals who align with our core values, purpose, mission, and vision. Final total compensation is based on a multitude of factors including, but not limited to, skill level, relevant experience to the position, and cost of labor.
Monthly Pay Range
EOE statement

We believe that our differences make us stronger, and thus foster a diverse and inclusive culture where people feel safe being themselves. TechnologyAdvice is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law.
Pre-employment screening required.

TechnologyAdvice does not engage with external staffing agencies. Any candidates introduced by such firms will not be eligible for compensation. TechnologyAdvice communicates only through @technologyadvice.com emails and official recruiting platforms. We never recruit via Teams, WhatsApp, or similar apps, and we will never request money, gift cards, or personal financial details during hiring.
Any AI-generated or incomplete application answers will be auto-rejected.

Job Overview:

As our Senior Bookkeeper, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining accurate financial records for multiple clients. This role involves overseeing daily bookkeeping activities, preparing financial reports, and ensuring compliance with accounting standards. The ideal candidate will have extensive bookkeeping experience, excellent organizational skills, and a keen attention to detail.
Key Responsibilities:
Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records for clients, including recording transactions, reconciling accounts, and managing ledgers.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.
Reconcile bank statements, credit card statements, and other accounts to ensure accuracy and identify discrepancies.
Oversee payroll processing, including calculating and recording payroll transactions, ensuring compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
Manage accounts payable and receivable, including processing invoices, payments, and collections.
Assist in the preparation of tax returns and provide support during tax audits.
Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, and stay updated on changes in accounting standards and practices.
Train junior Bookkeepers as the team grows and less experienced team members come onboard, providing guidance and support to enhance their professional development.
Skills & Experience:
Minimum of 4 years of Australian bookkeeping experience, within a public practice environment.
Proficiency in accounting software Xero.
Strong knowledge of Australian bookkeeping principles and practices.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

The Project Manager will own all pre-launch and in-flight coordination for LilyPad projects, ensuring seamless execution from planning through installation. This role serves as the primary point of contact for customers and internal teams, proactively managing schedules, documentation, permitting, and cross-functional coordination to keep projects on track.
Key Responsibilities
Own all pre-launch and in-flight coordination for LilyPad projects.
Schedule and dispatch contractors and subcontractors for site walks and surveys.
Confirm all documents needed for each project, including electrical, structural, and civil drawings, permits, and other required materials; develop and maintain a checklist for each project.
Collect and validate customer-provided documents such as utility bills, site plans, photos, and related requirements.
Coordinate permitting timelines with electrical contractors and customers.
Manage internal kick-off meetings and create, maintain, and share project timelines.
Serve as the single point of contact for customers regarding schedule changes, delays, and questions during the installation phase.
Chase internal stakeholders (engineering, procurement, field operations) to keep projects on schedule.
Identify and flag at-risk projects early and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution.
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
Experience in project coordination or project management, preferably in construction, electrical, or infrastructure-related projects.
Strong organizational and scheduling skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent communication skills for coordinating with customers, contractors, and internal teams.
Ability to proactively identify risks and drive resolution across stakeholders.
Comfortable working with documentation, checklists, and timelines in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with permitting processes and contractor coordination.
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, procurement, and field operations teams.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Benefits
Above market salary
HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents
Government-mandated benefits
Performance-based Incentives
Quarterly Company Events
1,000 PHP De Minimis
Equipment and software provided

BRING STORIES TO LIFE THROUGH DESIGN, VIDEO, AND CREATIVITY!
Create compelling visual content that brings campaigns to life and connects future students with our brand.
Guide, Uplift, and Soar in a #GreatPlaceToWork:
Health & Security: HMO (up to 2 dependents) + Life Insurance
Growth & Development: Training Programs & Learning Opportunities
Work-Life Balance: 30 PTOs and Leave Conversion
Family Support: Parental & Maternity Benefits
Additional Perks: Transportation, Internet, Clothing, Laundry & Rice Allowances
100% Work From Home: Work remotely from anywhere in the Philippines
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM (PH Time)
HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO BE OUR GRAPHIC DESIGNER / VIDEO EDITOR?
2-3 years of experience in graphic design and video editing , preferably in a marketing, education, or student recruitment environment.
Strong portfolio showcasing digital design, social media content, video editing, campaign assets, and print materials .
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite , particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, and After Effects.
Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other digital content platforms , including formats and creative approaches that drive engagement.
Experience creating both short-form and long-form video content for promotional, informational, and campaign purposes.
Ability to manage multiple creative projects, prioritize tasks, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining brand consistency across digital and print materials.
Basic knowledge of print production and file preparation for professional printing.
Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with marketing and internal teams.
Ability to take creative direction while also contributing fresh ideas and proactive creative solutions .
Willingness to stay updated on social media trends, design styles, content formats, and video editing techniques .
DAY IN THE LIFE OF A GRAPHIC DESIGNER / VIDEO EDITOR
Creating Video Content for Digital Campaigns
Create and edit engaging short-form videos , including Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts, to support marketing campaigns and increase audience engagement.
Edit longer-form videos for promotional, informational, campus, and student-life content.
Develop eye-catching video thumbnails, covers, and supporting visual assets optimized for social media platforms.
Optimize video formats, dimensions, and outputs for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, websites, and other digital channels.
Designing Social Media & Digital Assets
Develop creative assets for social media, including static posts, carousels, stories, and campaign visuals .
Translate campaign objectives and concepts into visually compelling content that attracts and informs prospective students.
Ensure all digital content follows brand guidelines and maintains a consistent visual identity.
Collaborate with the marketing team to align creative output with campaign goals, messaging, and brand voice.
Producing Print & Marketing Materials
Create print-ready materials such as brochures, flyers, posters, event signage, and other promotional collateral .
Prepare artwork and files according to professional printing requirements.
Maintain consistency across digital and physical marketing materials.
Supporting Campaigns & Student Recruitment
Contribute creative concepts for marketing campaigns, events, and student recruitment initiatives .
Work closely with the marketing team to brainstorm and execute ideas from concept through final production.
Create visual content that supports the student journey and strengthens engagement with prospective students.
Managing Creative Projects & Deadlines
Manage multiple design and video projects simultaneously while meeting established timelines.
Prioritize tasks based on campaign requirements and business needs.
Incorporate feedback and creative direction while proactively identifying opportunities to improve content.
Maintain organized working files and ensure final assets are properly prepared and delivered.
Staying Current & Creating On-Site Content
Stay informed about emerging social media trends, design styles, editing techniques, and content formats .
Identify creative opportunities to keep content fresh, relevant, and competitive.
Support on-site content creation when needed, including filming campus activities, events, and student life .

About WizeMentoring

WizeMentoring supports accounting and bookkeeping firm owners around the world to build high-performing, profitable businesses. Through proven systems and expert mentoring, we help our clients improve efficiency, strengthen leadership and achieve long-term sustainable growth. With over 20 staff in 9 different countries, we are growing rapidly and are looking for our next star team member!
Visit our website to learn more:
Job Overview

We are looking for a reliable, well-organised Virtual Assistant / Appointment Setter to manage appointments and scheduling for clients. This is a part-time position ideal for someone who wants meaningful, flexible work that fits around other commitments.

You'll essentially act as Samee (Samantha Regalado, our WizeGrowth & Advisory Success Specialist), with inbox and calendar access to manage meetings and communicate with clients on her behalf. Keeping every interaction professional, prompt, and personable.
Why Join WizeMentoring
Hourly rate: PHP 300 - 450
Flexible, part-time hours (averaging 1 hour/day, up to a maximum of 10 hours/week, across 5 days/week)
100% remote work from home
Supportive and forward-thinking leadership team
Opportunity to build long-term
Your Role

As a dedicated assistant/appointment setter, your focus will be managing the scheduling process and attending to queries for all WizeGrowth and WizeAdvisory clients. As such, a warm, professional, and clear communication style is essential, ensuring every interaction feels prompt and personable.
Reports to Samee (Samantha Regalado)
Key Responsibilities
Scheduling & Calendar Management
Coordinate and book appointments for clients via Outlook and Zoom, avoiding scheduling conflicts
Confirm, reschedule, and follow up on appointments promptly
Send appointment reminders and confirmations to clients
Flag any scheduling issues or conflicts to Samee proactively
Client Communication
Handle client scheduling queries with prompt, professional responses
Communicate with clients via Microsoft Teams, email, and/or phone with a professional, friendly tone
Meeting Preparation & Follow-Up
Help prepare agendas, links, and materials, and follow up to ensure clients are ready ahead of meetings
Save, organise, and file meeting recordings and notes after each session
Client Records & Onboarding
Keep client records clean, accurate, and up to date, flagging any gaps to Samee
Manage onboarding admin tasks and flag missing info or outstanding items to Samee
Task Tracking & Support
Track outstanding client tasks and escalate anything needing Samee's attention
Assist Samee with ad-hoc tasks as needed
Tech-savvy, with confident, hands-on experience using Microsoft Teams and Outlook
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication skills
Good interpersonal skills and a warm, professional client-facing manner
Highly organised, reliable and punctual
Comfortable working independently in a remote, part-time capacity
Prior experience as a receptionist, scheduler, or virtual assistant is a plus
Our Ideal Candidate
When you join WizeMentoring, you're not just getting a job. You're joining a fast-moving, impact-driven remote team that values ownership, excellence, and growth. Apply Today!
